summary: Retain HTML runtime for form-associated custom-element lifecycle and ElementInternals coupling.

target.notes: Preserve form owner association and formAssociatedCallback/formDisabledCallback/formResetCallback/formStateRestoreCallback ordering, plus ElementInternals validity/value/state integration.

caveats: This behavior crosses FORM and Custom Elements semantics and requires the retained HTML custom-element model.

tests.name: reset callback participates in form reset
tests.input: /* a form-associated custom element with formResetCallback inside a form, followed by form.reset() */
tests.expected_behavior: formResetCallback is invoked through custom-element reactions

tests.name: association callback observes owner changes
tests.input: /* move a form-associated custom element between form owners */
tests.expected_behavior: formAssociatedCallback receives the new owner, including null when disassociated
